text:
alex: Quick sync - pulled a one-pager with Hosted / Dedicated / Private variants. Need voice alignment before tomorrow's design review at 9:30am. Sharing link: https://drive.fake/redwood-site-copy. @maria can you lead?

maria: On it. Quick question - do we keep 'predictable throughput' on Hosted or save that for Dedicated?

kevin: Save 'predictable' for Dedicated. Hosted should be 'fast time-to-value' + 'pay-as-you-go'. :thumbsup:

tanvi: Agree. For Private lead with 'data residency & compliance' - less product-y jargon like 'private control plane' in hero.

sam: Two quick headline options for Hosted:
- Hosted API: Start building with zero ops
- Hosted API: Production-grade inference in minutes
Which lands better?

maria: Prefer the second - 'Production-grade' signals reliability without being too nerdy.

alex: Keep bullets to 3 max. For Dedicated try a 3-bullet microcopy: 1) Predictable throughput 2) Reserved GPU pools 3) SLA-backed latency targets.

emma: Draft sentence for Private hero: 'Deploy Redwood in your VPC or on-prem for full data control and enterprise-grade auditing.' Thoughts?

kevin: Tone check: customer-facing but not vendor-speak. Avoid 'best-in-class' or 'industry-leading' unless we can back it with a metric.

tanvi: For Marketing: propose a small benchmark callout on Hosted hero (non-specific): 'Low p99 latencies for short prompt workloads - optimized for interactive apps.' If Legal asks for numbers we can gate it behind a footnote.

sam: Adding a tiny code CTA for the Hosted page - simple curl sample to reduce time-to-first-call for devs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Hello world"}'
```

alex: Action items: @maria finalize headlines (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) by EOD. @emma wire copy into Figma frames. @kevin confirm any benchmark callouts by EOD. @jamal update inbound routing rules for Private leads.

jamal: Noted. I'll route Private trial requests to sales@redwood.com with tag "private-eval" and add a priority rule so AE gets notified.

maria: Also: inbound CTA on Dedicated page should be explicit: 'Request dedicated capacity' -> /sales/dedicated?utm=site - that'll help lead scoring.

emma: I'll mock hero micro-animations that hint at 'unified runtime' vs 'isolated private deployment' so the visuals reinforce copy.

kevin: Final style note: keep headlines <= 90 chars, bullets short, and avoid nested clauses. :memo:

alex: Thanks - if no objections I'll drop this into the design-review thread at 9:30 and push the Figma link.

deploy-bot: design-review scheduled for 2026-03-22 09:30 UTC. Remember to attach final copy. :spiral_calendar:
